title: User Telemetry
desc:
If ON, EDCoPilot will send basic trace information to the backend server for support purposes: this comprises a) notification when it calls 3rd party external data sources (Spansh, Inara, eliteBGS etc), b) logging any application warning messages you receive in the VoiceLog, c) sending crash reports (the python application stacktrace) generated when a crash occurs. These notifications are reviewed to check for common errors or issues and to assist with troubleshooting user issues, and are retained for 14 days only before being automatically purged. 
PLEASE NOTE: EDCoPilot will always log basic user startup event information (Commander name, EDCoPilot version number being used), and will log application usage statistics  (duration that EDCoPilot was running, number of EDCoPilot user interactions or commands issued) on shutdown. This startup/shutdown data is used for application usage trending.

title: Debugging mode
desc: If ON, EDCoPilot will write more information to its log file for you to send to support, and will log your UI interactions to the back end server. Only enable this on request to assist support with troubleshooting an issue

title: EDCoPilot folder location
desc: Click to view / change where EDCoPilot is running from.

title: VoiceAttack folder location
desc: If using VoiceAttack, set this to the folder containing the VoiceAttack executable.

title: Elite Dangerous game journal folder location
desc:
The location of where the Elite journal file is written.
Usually under %userprofile%\Saved Games\Frontier Developments\Elite Dangerous

title: Lock to current journal file
desc: If ON, EDCoPilot will not check for a new journal file in the folder and will stay focussed on the current journal file only. Set this to ON if you have multiple game instances running on the same PC but do not wish EDCoPilot to keep switching between commanders. Note: you will need to either turn this OFF or restart EDCoPilot to pick up a new journal file.

title: Elite Dangerous key binds folder location
desc:
The location of where the Elite key binds files are stored.
Usually under %userprofile%\AppData\Local\Frontier Developments\Elite Dangerous\Options\Bindings

title: Running on Linux or Steam Deck?
desc: EXPERIMENTAL : Set this to ON if you are running on Linux or Steam Deck. This uses alternate logic for monitoring the logfiles, as well as alternate calls for functions such as switching screens
